prompts.title: Changes to Fernley village
prompts.prompt:
The plans below show the village of Fernley in 1995 and today.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

before: Farmland to the north of the main road
A small primary school in the centre
A post office next to the church
A narrow bridge over the river
after: A housing estate on the former farmland
The school extended with a sports field
A café in place of the post office
A wider bridge with a cycle lane
Woodland kept, with a new car park beside it

prompts.title: Letter to a neighbour about noise
prompts.prompt:
Your neighbour has recently started doing building work on their house, and the noise is causing you problems.

Write a letter to your neighbour. In your letter
- explain how the noise is affecting you
- suggest a solution
- say how you would like to stay in contact

Begin your letter as follows: Dear ...,

prompts.title: University education should be free
prompts.prompt:
Some people believe that university education should be free for all students, paid for by the government.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

prompts.title: Working from home
prompts.prompt:
Some people think that working from home is better for employees, while others believe that people work more effectively in an office.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

prompts.title: Traffic congestion in cities
prompts.prompt:

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

prompts.title: Children using smartphones
